tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Render and audit a live web page for WCAG 2.1/2.2 violations. Returns score, findings, and a shareable report URL. Free tier: 3 URL scans/day/IP; pass a Pro license email for more.

tools.name: scan_html
tools.description: Audit pasted HTML markup for WCAG violations (static rules — no render, no quota).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Fetch a stored scan report by its id (from a prior scan_url/scan_html result).

tools.name: list_rules
tools.description: List every WCAG criterion the scanner can emit, with level and detection path.
